words.prose: {{ar:أَنۢبَتَكُم}} ({{tr:ʾanbatakum}}) compresses the whole mechanism: a Form IV active perfect makes growth a completed caused act, and the attached {{ar:كُم}} ({{tr:kum}}) makes the addressees the grown object inside the verb. The plant-root is applied to humans, so origin is pictured as dependent organic emergence rather than autonomous self-sprouting or abstract manufacture. words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾarḍi}}) is not an indefinite patch of ground. Its definite singular form presents the known earth as a shared mass-domain, while the genitive after {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:min}}) locks that domain into the source role rather than making it a second object or loose scene noun. The local growth language selects soil/source from the wider earth range but keeps the larger terrestrial scale in view: the plural addressees arise from one recognized earth. words.prose: {{ar:نَبَاتًۭا}} ({{tr:nabātan}}) makes growth the last heard content of the ayah. As an accusative cognate verbal noun, it classifies and intensifies {{ar:أَنۢبَتَكُم}} ({{tr:ʾanbatakum}}), naming the caused emergence as growth itself rather than leaving the botanical sense implicit. Its result or state nuance survives under that cognate-accusative parse: the addressees are construed as the product and manner of growth, not as an independent object transported from earth. The indefinite, bare, collective form keeps the focus on qualitative growth rather than a bounded plant or an added evaluative adjective, unlike the qualified growth in 3:37. By returning the n-b-t root at closure after {{ar:مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:min al-ʾarḍi}}), the word seals the clause as a verb-to-noun growth ring and prepares the same-shape verbal-noun closure of being brought out again in 71:18.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative أَنۢبَتَ with plural object كُم, source phrase مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ, and cognate نَبَاتًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Plant emergence and agentive planting converge under Allah as grammatical subject: the human collective is not merely made of earth but deliberately cultivated out of fertile ground, with the cognate accusative foregrounding growth as the mode of making.

activation_trace.role: The fixed divine name identifies Allah as the explicit cultivator rather than leaving growth to an impersonal force.
Plant life emerging from earth supplies the literal material image and makes emergence the human-making mechanism.
Planting and cultivation by an agent make the causative verb an image of intentional tending, not spontaneous sprouting alone.
Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive medium from which the cultivated human life emerges.

changed_reading.after: Allah intentionally cultivates the human collective out of earth as living growth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَنۢبَتَكُم ... نَبَاتًا applies the growth root directly to human addressees.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root's human-growth branch includes being raised, fed, and brought to maturity, while its stock-and-place branch lets earth function as a developmental origin and setting. The verse can therefore span a life-course process rather than only an initial material formation.

activation_trace.role: Human growth and nurture, including raising and feeding, literalize the root for people and supply the developmental mechanism.
Stock, origin, and place of growth make earth the human developmental matrix rather than raw material only.

changed_reading.before: The plant comparison describes the instant of human formation.
changed_reading.after: The plant comparison can describe sustained human nurture and maturation rooted in terrestrial conditions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural كُم is governed by a root that can name newly arisen people within a group.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch of young or newly added people shifts the image from an isolated organism to a cohort. Read against the lower ground, the addressed community is a fresh human generation rising from a shared substrate.

activation_trace.role: Young people arising as additions to a group turn botanical emergence into a social and generational image.
Lower ground opposite the sky supplies the spatial below from which the collective is pictured as rising.

changed_reading.before: The verse states the earth-origin of humans in general.
changed_reading.after: The verse can address each human cohort as a newly arising generation from shared ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky cue's non-dominant mapped branch names first rain that marks earth with vegetation, while the downpour cue names abundant issuing from a source. Together they expand human growth from an earth-only image into a sky-water-soil circuit.

activation_trace.role: Plant growth emerging from earth is the focus-side effect whose enabling water source becomes visible in context.
Fertile ground is the focus-side receiving medium on which rain can leave vegetation.
The non-dominant mapped image of first rain marking earth with plants supplies the precise bridge from sky to terrestrial growth.
Abundant outflow from its source supplies the sustained water movement that enables the growth circuit.

structural_cues: At 71:11 the sky and abundant pouring occur in one clause; 71:12 then names gardens and rivers before 71:17 returns to earth and growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-marked vegetation and abundant outflow; I infer that the earlier water sequence exposes a causal support for أَنۢبَتَكُم. A live alternative is that 71:11-12 and 71:17 are parallel signs rather than one explanatory chain.

changed_reading.before: Earth alone is the material source of human growth.
changed_reading.after: Human growth belongs to a coupled providential circuit in which sky-borne water activates fertile earth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurring title رَبّ contributes repair, upbringing, and completion; its non-dominant mapped target adds feeding and growth. This specifies the agentive force of أَنۢبَتَكُم as sustained nurturing lordship rather than a single creative push.

activation_trace.role: Human raising, feeding, and maturation supply the focus-side process that the title of Lord can govern.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship function as continuous cultivation of the addressed people.
The non-dominant feeding-and-growth image sharpens the title into the material support of human development.

structural_cues: رَبّ recurs at 71:5, 71:10, 71:21, 71:26, and 71:28 around the focus's explicit divine subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring lordship plus nurture/completion and feeding/growth branches; I take the title to specify how Allah causes growth. It could instead remain a general title with no local causal force on 71:17.

changed_reading.before: Allah initiates human growth from earth.
changed_reading.after: Allah's lordship continuously feeds, raises, repairs, and completes the human growth initiated from earth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly uses a branch of increase and growth for worsening outcomes: flight and loss increase, then misguidance and destruction are requested to increase. This blocks an automatic equation between being grown and morally flourishing.

activation_trace.role: Human development supplies the focus-side growth whose moral direction the context complicates.
Increase and growth make the prophetic call yield a paradoxical growth in flight rather than receptivity.
The same increase-and-growth image makes wealth and offspring amplify loss, separating multiplication from flourishing.

structural_cues: The restriction pattern لَمْ يَزِدْ ... إِلَّا at 71:6 and 71:21 is echoed by لَا تَزِدْ ... إِلَّا at 71:24 and 71:28, always with adverse outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated adverse results and a growth branch for ز ي د; I infer a rhetorical counterpoint to ن ب ت that distinguishes ontological growth from moral fruit. The alternative is ordinary escalation language unrelated to the plant image.

changed_reading.before: To be grown by God implies an uncomplicated image of flourishing.
changed_reading.after: God-given human growth creates capacity, but that capacity can accumulate flight, loss, misguidance, or ruin rather than good fruit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sons are tied to lineage and derivation from an origin, while begetting supplies the event by which a new human appears. These cues activate the focus branch of young people added to a group, extending earth-growth across recurring generations.

activation_trace.role: Young people arising as additions to a group supply the focus-side model of a recurring human crop.
Sonship, lineage, and attribution to an origin turn the promised sons into continuations branching from an existing stock.
The event of birth supplies the recurrent mechanism by which another human generation emerges.

structural_cues: Sons at 71:12, child at 71:21, begetting at 71:27, and parents at 71:28 form a lineage sequence around the plural addressees of 71:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lineage, birth, and the focus branch for newly arisen people; I infer that the growth image can recur through descent. The alternative is that the family vocabulary concerns separate blessings and blame without extending the earth metaphor.

changed_reading.before: A single human collective once emerged from earth.
changed_reading.after: Human society keeps emerging as a generational crop, with each cohort branching from prior stock while sharing an ultimate earthen origin.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation as measuring and the succession of states give temporal architecture to human nurture. Growth is an ordered passage through calibrated forms, not an undifferentiated leap from earth to finished person.

activation_trace.role: Human growth and maturation supply the process whose internal temporal structure is clarified by the earlier verse.
Measuring and proportioning make each phase of growth deliberate and calibrated.
Successive stages and states supply the temporal sequence through which the human growth proceeds.

structural_cues: خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا at 71:14 and أَنۢبَتَكُم ... نَبَاتًا at 71:17 share the plural object and an accusative expression that characterizes the manner or result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation and successive states; I infer that 71:14 specifies how the human growth of 71:17 unfolds. They may instead be adjacent but independent proofs of creative power.

changed_reading.before: Human growth from earth is a single creative event.
changed_reading.after: Human growth from earth is a measured developmental sequence whose changing forms are themselves part of divine cultivation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate return into the same earth and a renewed outward passage transform sprouting from an origin scene into the first arc of a cycle: emergence, return, concealment, and re-emergence.

activation_trace.role: Plant emergence from earth supplies the first outward phase of the cycle.
The lower ground is both the place of first emergence and the medium of later return.
Return after departure and repetition after a beginning bends the linear growth image back into earth.
Passage to the outside supplies the second emergence and completes the cyclical mechanism.

structural_cues: 71:18 follows with ثُمَّ, refers back to earth with فِيهَا, and pairs يُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا with the causative-plus-cognate pattern of أَنۢبَتَكُم ... نَبَاتًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return into earth followed by outward emergence; I infer that botanical growth models human death and renewed life as one cycle. A live alternative is two distinct acts linked only by divine power, without a seasonal analogy.

changed_reading.before: The verse speaks only about the beginning of human life.
changed_reading.after: The beginning is one phase in an earth-mediated cycle of growth, burial-like return, and decisive re-emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plant metaphor initially suggests rooted fixity, but the following spread earth, penetrable paths, and wide mountain passes recast the grown humans as mobile beings. Earth is simultaneously nursery, support, and circulation surface.

activation_trace.role: Earth-emergent plant life supplies the expectation of rootedness that the subsequent movement vocabulary overturns.
Earth as a spread carpet turns the growth medium into an inhabitable and traversable support.
Penetrating and proceeding along a road supplies purposeful human movement across the former growth medium.
An extended path meant to be traveled turns terrestrial extension into a network for the grown collective.
A broad opening between mountains supplies large-scale passages through which earth-grown humans circulate.

structural_cues: 71:19-20 immediately follow the emergence-return sequence, repeat earth explicitly, and use مِنْهَا to make that same terrain the site of travel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spread terrain and path movement; I infer a deliberate contrast with the rooted plant image, so growth issues in mobility. The alternative is that traversability is a separate favor with no corrective force on the metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Humans are likened to plants fixed in the ground that produced them.
changed_reading.after: Earth grows humans into mobile agents and is then prepared as the support and route-system for their movement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The thick-mat branch of the earth root is remote from the ordinary sense of أَرْض, so it should not replace 'earth.' It remains packet-anchored because 71:19 immediately calls that earth a spread carpet; render it only as a secondary lexical resonance in which the growth bed is also prepared bedding.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ names the bed of growth, and the focus inventory itself contains a thick-mat branch.

activation_trace.role: The rare thick-mat image lets the earth of growth also appear as laid bedding or support.
Human nurture makes the mat-like earth function as a nursery bed rather than inert flooring.
The explicit image of earth as a spread carpet locally ratifies the otherwise distant mat resonance.

changed_reading.before: Earth is soil or material from which humans grow.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, earth is also a deliberately laid nursery-bed that supports the life raised from it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Watering land and crop is branch-distant from مَكَرُوا in its immediate scheming construction, so it cannot serve as a lexical gloss. It remains valid as a material activation because the exact context root is cognately intensified and the focus has just framed its human agents as cultivated growth; downstream prose should label the result an exploratory counter-cultivation analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَنۢبَتَكُم ... نَبَاتًا frames the later schemers themselves as a cultivated human crop.

activation_trace.role: Agentive planting supplies the governing cultivation model from which a rival human cultivation can be imagined.
Watering earth and crop turns emphatic scheming into an exploratory image of tending and sustaining an opposing social growth.
A watered plant or tree supplies the possible product of that counter-cultivation: a scheme made to take root and persist.

changed_reading.before: God alone cultivates the human actors, who later happen to scheme.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cultivated humans become counter-cultivators who water a rival social crop of schemes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Covering seed is a materially apt but semantically distant branch for كَفَّارًا; it must not redefine unbelief as agriculture. The activation remains anchored in the focus's plant growth and 71:27's explicit begetting, so it may be rendered cautiously as an image of a human crop that conceals its own seed, source, or benefaction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus makes the addressed lineage earth-grown, while the human-growth inventory includes young people arising within a group.

activation_trace.role: Newly arisen young people supply the human-crop lineage to which the later birth statement can attach.
Actual begetting supplies the propagation mechanism by which the human crop produces another generation.
Covering seed supplies the surprising reversal in which propagated growth hides the source from which growth comes.

changed_reading.before: Human lineage simply continues the earth-grown collective.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a lineage can become a crop that propagates while covering its own seed, source, and cultivator.

strongest_changes: One-time earthen creation became sustained cultivation under a Lord whose split-root inventory contributes nurture, completion, feeding, and growth.
The immediate return into earth and renewed exit changed first growth into a full emergence-return-reemergence cycle.
Rain that marks earth with vegetation and measured successive stages supplied environmental and temporal mechanisms for human growth.
Repeated increases in flight, loss, misguidance, and ruin removed the assumption that ontological growth guarantees moral flourishing.
summary.what_was_special: Non-dominant and branch-distant packet images were unusually productive: ر ب ب supplied feeding and growth, س م و supplied first rain marking earth with plants, and the earth-mat, plot-watering, and seed-covering branches generated contained secondary readings without displacing the ordinary constructions.
remaining_uncertainties: The rain, stage, and mobility sequences may be causal specifications of 71:17 or parallel signs placed beside it.
The generational crop is well anchored lexically, but its scope beyond the addressed community remains uncertain.
The mat, counter-cultivation, and seed-covering readings are live resonances rather than claims about the direct contextual senses of their trigger words.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Human creation is recast as cultivated emergence.** The doubled root activates **ن ب ت B001** (plant growth from earth), **B002** (cultivation), and **B006** (human growth and nurture), while **ء ر ض B001–B002** supplies ground and its fertile softness. The verb plus cognate accusative intensifies the growth model. The packet supplies divine causation, earthly source, and plant-like emergence; the abductive arrow is that human formation depends on a cultivated environment. The ayah reads as nurtured growth rather than fabrication alone.

2. **The rain, garden, and human sequences become one ecology.** 71:11–12 supplies pouring water, swelling support, gardens, and rivers; **ن ب ت B001** and **ء ر ض B002** now supply the growth process and receptive substrate. The inferred causal chain is water → fertile ground → growth, with humans included in rather than placed outside that chain. The ayah therefore activates ecological dependence as evidence against self-magnification.

3. **Growth includes lineage and social replenishment.** **ن ب ت B003** supplies young people arising within a group and **B005** their stock or place of growth. This is activated by sons in 71:12, wealth and offspring in 71:21, birth in 71:27, and parents in 71:28. The packet supplies those genealogical recurrences; the abductive arrow is that a people grows from an earthly and familial stock. The ayah gains a collective-generational reading alongside bodily origin.

4. **Fertile origin implies aptitude for good.** **ء ر ض B003** supplies being fit for good like fertile ground. The command sequence in 71:3 provides the unrealized good, and 71:21–24 provides the contrary trajectory. The fit-to-good role is lexical; the claim that refusal wastes that fitness is abductive. The ayah then reads as an indictment of failed cultivation, not a claim that their later conduct was built into their origin.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 71:18 completed the plant analogy by returning humans to earth and bringing them out again. 71:27–28 then made its social and genealogical branches unavoidable: birth can reproduce corruption, but parents and a believing household can also enter forgiveness.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Humans inside the ecology of cultivation.** **Lexical evidence:** `ن ب ت B001` is plant growth emerging from earth, and `ن ب ت B006` is human growth and nurture; the verb and cognate accusative double the root. **Structural cue:** within 71:12-22, gardens and rivers precede the verse, and return to earth follows it. **Assigned role:** plant emergence models embodied human dependence on substrate, nourishment, and cultivation. **Abductive move:** the packet explicitly licenses the human-growth branch; I infer that the plant image embeds people within, rather than above, the ecology. **Reading change:** human creation reads as cultivated emergence.

2. **Generation as moral-social cultivation.** **Lexical evidence:** `ن ب ت B003` is young people arising in a group; `ب ن ي B007` at 71:12 and `و ل د B001` at 71:21 supply offspring. **Structural cue:** the provision of children is followed by human planting, then by leaders whose wealth and offspring amplify loss. **Assigned role:** social influence acts as cultivation shaping the new growth. **Abductive move:** I infer that what feeds a generation can be material and directive. **Reading change:** `أنبتكم` includes the vulnerability of human development to communal cultivation.

3. **Earth as a nursery with capacity.** **Lexical evidence:** `ء ر ض B002` is soft fertile ground and `ن ب ت B005` is a stock or place of growth. **Structural cue:** emergence `من الأرض` is followed by return into the same ground at 71:18 and by its spread use at 71:19-20. **Assigned role:** earth holds origin, sustenance, return, and renewed emergence. **Abductive move:** I infer nursery-like continuity from these recurring functions. **Reading change:** earth is an active growth-medium in the mechanism, not merely a material point of origin.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The wealth-and-offspring amplifier at 71:21 and the system-scale scheme at 71:22 confirmed that human growth is socially cultivable. Material increase can feed leaders whose direction shapes new communal growth, so the plant analogy carries vulnerability as well as dependence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The prayer's resident is not just an isolated individual. Dwelling, fixed attachment, settlement, and hostile encirclement make residence a durable claim; leaving and breaking reverse it. The prepared earth can therefore move from hospitable infrastructure to a territory deliberately cleared of a destructive occupancy.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Following Converts Increase Into Multiplying Loss
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Allegiance propagates a governing direction, so assets and descendants amplify either ordered life or the loss already embedded in their leader.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Loss behaves like a bad balance sheet and a reproductive process: capital, claims, speech, followers, and offspring all enlarge the same deficit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Error reproduces itself through numbers and generation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Misguidance spreads across a crowd and then through offspring, turning a present deviation into a durable lineage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deviation from path and guidance (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); loss of the thing or its location (`quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`); failed retention and memory (`quranic:root_000913:B004/m01`); increase and accretion (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); multiplication of number (`quranic:root_001286:B001/m01`); new human generation (`quranic:root_001465:B003/m01`); childbirth (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); derivative generated from a prior source (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`); transgressive rupture (`quranic:root_001132:B004/m01`); covering and denial of truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); coercion into disobedience (`quranic:root_001307:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The process has both horizontal and vertical propagation. Deviation spreads through many contemporaries, then childbirth and derivation carry it into another generation. Forgetting and loss show how guidance disappears from transmission, while coercion explains how a formed social system can make later disobedience easier.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] The Plot Is Cultivated Beneath a Treated Surface
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A destructive plan develops through hidden preparation, managed inputs, and a surface that conceals the condition of what is ripening underneath.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Plotting becomes an agricultural and cosmetic operation: water the hard ground, grow the plant, coat the exterior, and discover rot in the fruit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Managed growth can culminate in rotten yield
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Hard ground is watered, a named plant is raised, and apparently successful cultivation terminates in spoiled fruit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: watering hard earth before cultivation (`quranic:root_001438:B005/m01`); irrigated plant or tree (`quranic:root_001438:B003/m01`); rotten ripe date (`quranic:root_001438:B006/m01`); date spoiled by cold before ripening (`quranic:root_001255:B004/m01`); waterskin spoiled under moonlight (`quranic:root_001255:B006/m01`); deliberate planting (`quranic:root_001465:B002/m01`); plant emerging from ground (`quranic:root_001465:B001/m01`); seed covered with earth (`quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`); fruit enclosed in its sheath (`quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`); palm heart or shoot (`quranic:root_001286:B006/m01`); fertile ground (`quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The cultivation is technically competent but teleologically corrupt. Watering, planting, seed-cover, and fruit-sheath all support growth, yet the final yield is rotten. This reframes the “great plot” as sustained investment in an outcome whose decay is internal to the process.

Dal framingi bu insan topluluğu anlamını, bireysel büyüme ve özel ad dallarından doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bir topluluğa sonradan katılan genç veya yeni kuşağı anlatır; tek kişinin yetişmesi, soyun bütünü ya da özel topluluk adı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın adlar genç ve deneyimsiz yeni kuşağı anlatır; kötülük niteliği yalnız bunu açıkça belirten yapı içinde eklenen bir uzmanlaşmadır.

concept_map.definition: Bir aile veya topluluk içinde doğup yetişerek sonradan ona katılan genç ve deneyimsiz yeni kuşaktır. Belirli bir yapıda bu yeni grup kötülükle de nitelenebilir.

facets.statement: Bir topluluk içinde doğup yetişen küçükler, gençler veya deneyimsiz yeni üyeler sonradan beliren bir kuşak oluşturur.
Yeni ortaya çıkan topluluk, yalnız belirli bir yapıda kötülük niteliğiyle sınırlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, bir toplulukta doğup büyüyen ve daha sonra ona eklenen genç kuşağı temel alır. Bu kuşak küçük çocuklar, deneyimsiz gençler veya sonradan yetişen insanlar olarak görünür; ayrıca belirli bir kullanımda kötülükle nitelenir.

concept_gloss.text: bir toplulukta sonradan yetişen genç kuşak

error_profile.preserves: Topluluğu, genç kuşağı, yetişmeyi ve sonradan katılmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir aile veya toplulukta doğup büyüyerek görünür hale gelen genç üyelerden söz edildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yeni ortaya çıkan ve yetişen genç kuşak anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yeni ortaya çıkan topluluğun açıkça kötülükle nitelendiği özel yapı için açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yeni grup olmayı ve kötülük niteliğini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kökten türeyen çeşitli biçimlerin kişi adı ve topluluk adı olarak kullanıldığını açıkça bildirir. Bunlar büyüme anlamının tanımları değil, söz konusu biçimlerin adlaşmış kullanımlarıdır; dalın özel ad alanında tutulması bu ayrımı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız kişi ve topluluk adlarını kapsar; genç kuşak, bitki büyümesi veya belirli ağaç adı anlamları buraya alınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tek sözcüklü kişi ve topluluk adlarıyla bir soy bildiren ad öbeği aynı özel ad alanındadır; bunlardan genel büyüme veya topluluk anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kökten türeyen belirli biçimlerin kişi adı veya belirli bir halk, boy ya da soy topluluğunun adı olarak kullanılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bazı biçimler belirli halk, boy veya soy topluluklarının adı olarak kullanılır.
Bazı tek sözcüklü biçimler insanlara verilen kişi adları olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, aynı kök ailesindeki biçimlerin hem kişi adı hem de belirli halk, boy veya soy topluluklarının adı olabildiğini birlikte aktarır. Bu ad kullanımları genel büyüme ve yetişme anlamlarından ayrıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Verilen bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; farklı kabile ve kişi adları aynı adlandırma alanını tekrarladığı için tek temsilci seçildi, ayrıca özel topluluk adı ile yeni kuşak anlamını ayıran kök içi karşılaştırma korundu.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin yetiştiği yer ile kişinin geldiği kökeni aynı yer-köken şeması altında verir; ayrıca bir şeyin yetişme biçimi veya içinde geliştiği durum için ayrı bir görünüş facetini içerir. Dal korunabilir, ancak köken ve yetişme yeri ile yetişme hali tek bir eşanlamlı anlam gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kökeni, yetişme yerini ve yetişme biçimini kapsar; genç kuşak ya da büyüme eyleminin kendisi bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimler köken, yetişme yeri veya yetişme halini karşılar; soylu köken ve bir ailenin malıyla çocuklarının geliştiği durum yalnız kendi yapılarında özelleşir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin yetiştiği yer veya bir kişinin geldiği köken ile bir varlığın hangi durum ve görünüş içinde geliştiğini anlatır. Belirli yapılarda kökenin iyi ve saygın oluşu ya da bir ailenin malı ve çocuklarının geliştiği durum ayrıca belirtilir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın yetiştiği yer, insan bakımından da geldiği köken olarak kavranır.
Belirli bir yapıda kişinin kökeninin iyi, dürüst ve saygın oluşu vurgulanır.
Bir şeyin büyürken aldığı durum, görünüş ve gelişme biçimi de aynı şemayla anlatılır.
Bir aileye bağlı kullanım, malın ve çocukların içinde geliştiği genel hal veya kökeni anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yetişme yerini kökenle ilişkilendirir ve iyi kökeni belirten özel bir kullanım verir. Aynı anlam alanı, bitki veya başka bir varlığın gelişirken aldığı hal ve görünüşe, ayrıca bir ailenin malı ile çocuklarının geliştiği duruma uzanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanda büyüme, ergenliğe yaklaşma, belirli beden tüyünün görünmesi ve bir çocuğu besleyip iyi yetiştirme anlamlarını açıkça destekler. Bir kaynak anlamı bütün büyüyen canlılara genişletse de bu dalın tanıklanan birimleri insan yapılarıdır; genel canlı büyümesi dalın yalın anlamı gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal insanın bireysel gelişimi ve bakım yoluyla yetiştirilmesiyle sınırlıdır; genç topluluğu, tarımsal dikimi veya genel canlı büyümesini yalın anlam olarak kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: İnsan gelişimi, ergenlik belirtisi ve besleyip yetiştirme anlamları yalnız tanıklanan insan odaklı yapılarda geçerlidir; bunlardan bağımsız bir yalın anlam türetilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir çocuğun büyüyüp ergenliğe yaklaşması ve bunun kasık tüyünün görünmesiyle anlaşılması ya da bir çocuğun beslenip iyi bakılarak yetiştirilmesidir. Büyüme şeması daha genel canlılara uygulanabilse de dalın tanıklanan çekirdeği insandır.

facets.statement: Çocuğun büyüyerek ergenliğe yaklaşması, kasık tüyünün görünmesiyle belirginleşir.
Bir çocuğu beslemek, bakımını iyi yürütmek ve böylece sağlıklı biçimde yetişmesini sağlamak anlatılır.
İnsan büyümesini taşıyan şema, bir aktarımda bitki, hayvan ve insan dahil bütün büyüyen canlılara genişletilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: İnsan odaklı anlatım iki yönlüdür: çocuk büyüyüp ergenlik eşiğine gelir ve bunun kasık tüyünün görünmesiyle anlaşıldığı belirtilir; ya da bir yetişkin çocuğu besleyip iyi bakarak büyütür. Ayrıca büyüme fikrinin bitki, hayvan ve insan dahil bütün canlılara uygulanabildiği daha geniş bir aktarım vardır.

concept_map.definition: Yerle ilişkilendirilen görünmez varlıkların etkisine bağlanan bir akıl ve beden bozukluğudur; etkilenen kişi başını ve gövdesini isteği dışında hareket ettirir.

facets.statement: Kişinin akıl ve beden durumu görünmez varlıkların etkisine bağlanır.
